[{"table_name":"team_zone_permission","name":"trg_team_zone_scope","enabled":"O","definition":"CREATE TRIGGER trg_team_zone_scope BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF team_id, contractor_zone_permission_id, valid_from, valid_until ON team_zone_permission FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_team_zone_scope()","function_name":"validate_team_zone_scope","configuration":null,"body":" BEGIN

        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid team Zone scope or interval' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      RETURN NEW; END "}]
